task: Issue #225: reusable RPY hydrodynamics archive and fixed-camera flow overlay
summary: Opt-in hydro_archive stores 1 ms-cadence bead positions and total forces for compact RPY runs.
Post-processing reconstructs self/other/source velocity contributions and RPY velocity at arbitrary spatial points without storing mobility matrices or flow grids.
Campaign analysis writes archive-aligned contribution time series, a nine-condition comparison CSV, a full-duration body-fixed axial-flow figure, and a count-comparison figure.
The replay entry point renders either one condition or the required n=1/2/3 phase_seed=0 3-panel overlay with follow_camera_3d forced to false.
A cs10-qualified nine-shard parallel job and the fixed-commit queue/runbook contract are included.
